headline: DeepSeek still holds 38.0% of tokens, and Tencent's new hy4-flash crashes the top four at #4
summary: DeepSeek's grip hasn't loosened: it holds 38.0% of tokens, and the top two providers together account for 47.3%. Tencent's hy4-flash debuted straight into the number four slot at 5.9%, which is a very confident entrance.
highlights: Google's gemini-4-carbon set a fresh all-time token share record at 1.1% and jumped nine spots to #23 in a single day.
Tencent's older hy4 now sits at #8 with 3.4%, while its newer sibling takes the #4 spot.
Anthropic gained 1.7 points of provider share in a day, now at 7.1% overall.
The top four providers (DeepSeek, Tencent, Anthropic, OpenAI) hold 61.4% of tokens between them.
Tencent's hy3 fell off the board after last ranking #31 with 0.6% of tokens.
